plan.text: Captain, pichhli baar sitting khuli aur maine ek shabd nahi bola. Meri galti. Aaj ka map: neuralnet, axis a, yaani kya hai. Chaar stop. Ek: neuron ek dhaba cook jaisa. Do: tum haath se ek neuron chalaoge. Teen: cooks ki line, yaani layers. Chaar: tumhara Bolo. End pe neural network tumhare apne shabdon mein hoga. Shuru karein?

Stop ek, chaar mein se. Pehle tasveer: ek dhaba ka kitchen. Order andar aata hai, cooks ki ek line kaam karti hai, plate bahar nikalti hai. Ab naam. 'Neural network' matlab bahut saare chhote decision-makers ka jaal. Har decision-maker ko 'neuron' kehte hain. Ek line mein, neuron ek chhota cook hai. Woh kuch cheezein leta hai, unhe tolta hai, aur ek faisla aage bhejta hai. Abhi bas itna store karo. Tolna kaise hota hai, woh agle unit mein khulega. Abhi ek hi idea: network matlab cooks ka kitchen.

Stop ek abhi chal raha hai, teen baaki. Ek cook ko zoom karo. Woh chai bana raha hai. Uske paas teen cheezein aati hain: cheeni, adrak, doodh. Inhe kehte hain 'input', matlab jo cheez cook tak pahunchti hai. Ab cook har cheez ko barabar nahi maanta. Adrak uske liye bahut important hai, doodh thoda kam. Is ahmiyat ko kehte hain 'weight', matlab kis cheez ki kitni chalti hai. Cook har input ko uske weight se guna karta hai, sab jodta hai, aur ek total banata hai. Agar total ek had se upar gaya, to woh 'haan' aage bhejta hai. Is had ko kehte hain 'threshold'.

Stop ek ka check, phir stop do. Pehle apna gut-word bolo: knew, shaky ya guessed. Phir ek chhota sawaal, do option. Cook ke liye 'weight' kya hai? Option A: woh ingredient khud, jaise adrak. Option B: us ingredient ki kitni ahmiyat hai. Pehle gut-word, phir A ya B?

Stop do, chaar mein se, do baaki. Ab tum haath se chalaoge. Pehle main numbers dikhata hoon, tum abhi kuch mat karna. Cheeni daali gayi, to cheeni ka input 1. Adrak daali gayi, input 1. Doodh nahi daala, input 0. Weights ye hain: cheeni ka 2, adrak ka 3, doodh ka 1. Cook ka rule: total 4 ya usse zyada aaya to 'haan, chai achhi bani'. Kam aaya to 'na'. Kaagaz aur pen nikaal lo. Agle unit mein karna tumhe hai, mujhe nahi.

Stop do, haath wala kaam. Pehle gut-word: knew, shaky ya guessed. Phir kaagaz pe teen guna karo. Cheeni: 1 guna 2. Adrak: 1 guna 3. Doodh: 0 guna 1. Teeno jodo. Total kitna aaya? Aur cook 'haan' bolega ya 'na'? Pehle gut-word, phir total aur faisla?

Stop do khatam karte hain, jo tumne abhi haath se kiya usi ki trace ke saath. Ek: inputs aaye, cheeni, adrak, doodh. Do: har input ko uske weight se guna kiya. Teen: sab jod ke ek total banaya. Chaar: total ko had, yaani threshold, se milaya. Paanch: faisla aage bheja, haan ya na. Bas yahi ek neuron hai. Paanch kadam, har baar same. Ise ek baar mann mein dohra lo. Ab stop teen, aur uske baad sirf stop chaar baaki rahega.

Stop teen, chaar mein se, ek baaki. Ab poora kitchen dekho. Ek cook akela kuch khaas nahi kar sakta. Isliye cooks line mein khade hote hain, stations mein. Pehle station ke cooks ka faisla seedha customer ke paas nahi jaata. Woh agle station ke cook ka input ban jaata hai. Har station ko kehte hain 'layer', matlab ek hi kadam pe khade cooks ki ek kataar. Neural network matlab aisi kai layers, ek ke baad ek. Aakhri layer ka faisla hi bahar plate ban ke nikalta hai.

Stop teen ka check. Pehle gut-word: knew, shaky ya guessed. Phir do option. Beech wali layer ke cook ka faisla kahan jaata hai? Option A: seedha plate pe, customer ke paas. Option B: agle station ke cook ke paas, input ban ke. Pehle gut-word, phir A ya B?

Stop teen ka aakhri hissa. Shuru mein maine kaha tha ki network examples dekh ke seekhta hai. Uska matlab sirf ek line mein samajh lo. Socho naya dhaba hai aur cooks ko pata nahi ki adrak kitni important hai. Malik har chai chakh ke batata hai: zyada teekhi hai, ya feeki hai. Cooks apne weights thoda thoda badalte hain. Seekhna matlab bas yahi hai, weights ko dheere dheere sahi karna. Ye kaise hota hai, woh baad wale axis mein aayega. Aaj bas itna pakad lo: seekhna matlab weights badalna.

Stop chaar, aakhri. Ab tumhara Bolo. Main sirf khaali dhancha deta hoon, bharna tumhe hai. Neural network ek ___ hai. Iska sabse chhota hissa ___ hai. Woh kuch ___ leta hai, har ek ko ___ se tolta hai, sab jodta hai, aur ___ se milake faisla aage bhejta hai. Bahut saare aise hisse ek kataar mein matlab ___. Seekhna matlab ___ badalna. Hinglish mein bolo, apni awaaz mein, dheere. Pehle gut-word: knew, shaky ya guessed. Phir poora Bolo shuru karoge?
